source: Quest Helper plugin (github.com/Zoinkwiz/quest-helper) commit b9b93706618a7b7fe7e5ea30e9a9ef35ba09673e, folder thefeud; routes and dialogue checked against the OSRS Wiki quest guides (CC BY-NC-SA 3.0), November 2026

items: Combat Gear bring Range or Mage Gear if safe spotting.
rewards: Access to the Rogue Trader minigame

st.t: Talk to Ali Morrisane in Al Kharid to start the quest.
s: Are you really the greatest salesman in the world?
If you are, then why are you still selling goods from a stall?
I'd like to help you, but...

st.t: Talk to Ali Morrisane again and buy a Kharidian Headpiece and a Fake Beard to create a disguise.
Create a disguise by using the Kharidian Headpiece on the Fake Beard.
If you don't have a Shantay pass, buy one from Shantay, just north of the gate. Go through Shantay Pass.
Talk to the rug merchant and travel to Pollnivneach via magic carpet.
Go to the bar in the south-east of Pollnivneach. Buy 3 beers from Ali the Barman and use them on Drunken Ali to get him to explain where his son is. Talk with him in full between beers.

sec.n: Find the beef between the two factions

st.t: Talk to a Menaphite Thug, just west of the bar, to figure out how their dispute started with the bandits.
Talk to a bandit by the general store in the north of Pollnivneach to figure out their issues with the Menaphites.
With 500 coins and 2 free inventory spaces, talk to Ali the Camel Man at the camel store, just north-west of the bar, to try and get two camels to solve the dispute.
s: Are those camels around the side for sale?
What price do you want for both of them?
Would 500 gold coins for the pair of them do?

st.t: Tell the bandits that the Menaphites have agreed to return the camel.
Tell the Menaphites that the bandits have agreed to return the camel.
Talk to Ali the Operator in the big purple tent in the south-west of Pollnivneach to get a job from him.
s: Yes, of course, those bandits should be taught a lesson.

st.t: Try to pickpocket a villager once. It is meant to fail. Then talk to Ali the Operator and choose "Yeah, I could do with a bit of advice."

Find a street urchin around the bar or the town well, close to a villager, and pay him 10 coins to distract the villager. Quickly pickpocket the villager with the flashing arrow over his head, from behind. If it fails, talk to the urchin again.
Talk to Ali the Operator to get a blackjack.
s: Yeah, I could do with a bit of advice.

st.t: Equip the oak blackjack. Lure a villager to a secluded place or an empty building, knock them out and then pickpocket them.
Talk to Ali the Operator to get the second job.
Wear your desert disguise and leather or graceful gloves. Hide behind the large cactus near the mayor's house, the large house in the east of town by the fountain.
Use the keys on the door of the mayor's house.
Go up the stairs.
Search the painting to reveal the safe. Enter the code 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8.
Give Ali the Operator the jewels to get your final task from him.
Talk to a Menaphite member to find the traitor.
Talk to Ali and tell him you have found the traitor.
Talk to Ali the Barman to find out where Traitorous Ali is.
Talk to Ali the Hag, north-west of the well in the middle of town, to ask her to make some poison for you.
Use coins on the snake charmer's money pot, just south of the bar, to get a snake charm and a snake basket. You need 2 free inventory spaces.
s: Wow, a snake charmer. Can I have a go? Can I have a go? Please?

st.t: Use the Snake Charm on a snake, just north of Ali the Operator's big purple tent, to capture it.
Give the snake to Ali the Hag.
Talk to Ali the Kebab Salesman, north-west of the well in the middle of town, to get a special sauce to use.
s: Would you sell me that bottle of special kebab sauce?

st.t: If you have no empty bucket, pick one up just north-east of the trough.

Use the Red Hot Sauce on the trough behind the camel shop and wait for a Camel to poop out the dung. If you plan to do "My Arm's Big Adventure" or "Forgettable Tale of a Drunken Dwarf" then you may want to grab four more Ugthanki dung.
Use the bucket on the dung. Only pick up brown/Ugthanki dung.
Talk to Ali the Hag and give her the dung.
Use the poison on the beer glass on the table in the bar to kill Traitorous Ali.
Talk to Ali the Operator and tell him he is dead.

Talk to the Menaphite Leader, just outside Ali the Operator's big purple tent, and prepare for a fight against a tough guy. You can safespot him inside the tent by using a chair. If he doesn't appear, talk to the Menaphite Leader again.
Talk to a villager and they will be angry you broke the balance of power.

Talk to the Bandit Leader, who wanders around the magic carpet station in the north of town, and be prepared to fight a Bandit Champion. You can safe spot him with the stool in the house to the east. If he doesn't appear, talk to the Bandit Leader again.
Talk to a villager and they will be angry still.
Talk to Ali the Mayor, by the well in the centre of town, and get your due congratulations.
Talk to Ali Morrisane in Al Kharid to finish the quest.

i: Combat Gear bring Range or Mage Gear if safe spotting.
